name: WDOnline Wholesale for WooCommerce
author: wdonlinedk

sections.description:
WDOnline Wholesale for WooCommerce adds flexible wholesale pricing to WooCommerce while leaving normal retail customers unchanged.

Features include:

  • Wholesale customer groups with separate product prices.
  • Dedicated WD Wholesale Customer WordPress role for easy user filtering and integrations.
  • Wholesale Group sorting, filtering and bulk assignment on the WordPress Users screen.
  • Individual customer-specific price overrides.
  • Quantity-based tier pricing.
  • Wholesale sale prices with optional start and end dates.
  • Wholesale price display excluding VAT, including VAT, both, or following WooCommerce.
  • Quantity pricing table placement and styling controls.
  • Variable product support with parent-price fallback.
  • CSV import and export for wholesale pricing.
  • Optional integration with WD Online Support Diagnostics.
  • Conflict handling and a combined pricing table when WDOnline Quantity Discounts is active.
  • Custom colors and text sizes for the wholesale price label, original price, current price and VAT label.
  • Read-only including-VAT calculations next to wholesale price fields in the product editor.
  • Optional manual VAT exemption for individual customers.

All wholesale prices entered in the plugin are net prices excluding VAT/tax. WooCommerce calculates tax using the product tax class and customer location.

Support

Support WD Online via PayPal or card:
https://www.paypal.com/ncp/payment/NKERMAVC4PXML
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP through Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate WDOnline Wholesale for WooCommerce.
  3. Open WD Online > Wholesale.
  4. Configure wholesale groups and assign a group to each wholesale customer.
  5. Add wholesale and quantity pricing on WooCommerce products.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial public release.
  • Added wholesale customer groups, individual prices, sale periods and quantity-based pricing.
  • Added VAT display controls and optional customer VAT exemption.
  • Added variable product support and WooCommerce cart and checkout integration.
  • Added CSV import, validation, dry-run and filtered export tools.
  • Added frontend price and quantity-table styling controls.
  • Added optional integration with WDOnline Quantity Discounts and WD Online Support Diagnostics.
